lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed high-luminance circular clusters arranged in vertical columns along the lateral flank. Cluster diameter increases and inter-cluster spatial distance expands along the anterior-to-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the centroids of the circular clusters, creating a grid-like arrangement where blobs serve as anchor nodes within the stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper dorsal flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and a shadow-induced gradient below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density, stochastic distribution of small high-luminance blobs across its entire visible dorsal surface, contrasting with the more regular grid pattern on the mid-flank.
